title: Societies compared: verified targets for the money (planner-trial-2)

design.question: For the same agents, checker and money, does OSO reach the same verified targets for less than other ways of organizing the agents?
design.fixed: the same 4 agents (the single agent: the first, with all the money), $0.40 in all, Lean checks every proof
design.measure: money spent to verify 2 of the counted targets (C3, A3, C4, X1, B3, B5, X2, A5); a run that never does counts as its whole budget

caveats: Values are mean ± standard deviation over runs; the verdict compares runs in pairs (run k of each society), with ± two standard errors of the difference.
